prompt: Как называется тип болта, рассчитанный воспринимать срезную, а не растягивающую нагрузку?
note: FAA делит винты на конструкционные, машинные и самонарезающие группы.
individualGrammarPlausibilityUniqueKeyGr: Винт is a related fastener but is not presented as a bolt subtype. The question already demands тип болта, so the option can be rejected by category before assessing shear or tension. Mere thematic proximity is insufficient plausibility.
noteAllClaims: FAA 7-14(a) explicitly lists structural, machine and self-tapping as three basic screw groups. Attribution to FAA keeps this a reported classification rather than an exhaustive universal taxonomy.
noteGrammar: Readable complete Russian sentence; groups are parallel. Машинные is a literal technical label from machine screws and is intelligible alongside the source attribution.
individualUsefulness: Adds two other screw groups plus the classification, rather than repeating any shear-load clue.

individualGrammarPlausibilityUniqueKeyGr: Срезной болт is the only label containing any bolt type and repeats the stem root срез. It is uniquely keyed, but uniquely by label/category as well as load knowledge, invalidating the distractor contract.
noteAllClaims: RP p.26 explicitly cautions never to specify the described shear bolts/nuts for tension and halves torque-table values. The note names NASA and the card cites that manual.
noteGrammar: Two complete clauses; для них refers to the shear bolts just named.
individualUsefulness: The half-table-torque fact is genuinely additional to the load-oriented stem, although the prohibition on tension repeats part of it.
